name: Workspace Sync
description: Syncs workspace main tab group tabs with cursor positions by leaf ID (meaning you can have multiple positions saved for the same md file if you have multiple instances of the same md file in the workspace). Each workspace's sidebars (left, right) plus ribbon are kept via single platform-specific template (desktop or mobile). Excluded workspaces keep their own custom sidebar. Now with support for content search in open markdown files. EN and HU language support.
author: Otto Flott
